mapper.select:
select , t1.nickname as buyer_nickname, t1.avatar as buyer_avatar, t2.nickname as seller_nickname, t2.avatar as seller_avatar,
from `order` o left join (select id, nickname, avatar from `user`) t1 on o.buyer_id = t1.id left join (select id, nickname, avatar from `user`) t2 on o.seller_id = t2.id left join order_item oi on o.id = oi.order_id where o.id in
#{id}
order by o.create_time desc
